name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd
about: Kirloskar Brothers is a part of the Kirloskar Group engaged in the business of engineering and manufacturing of systems for fluid management. The core businesses include large infrastructure projects (Water Supply, Power Plants, and Irrigation), Pumps, Valves, Motors and Hydro turbines. [1] [2]
keyPoints:
Product Offerings[1]
The company has 250+ product categories with 100,000+ SKUs catering to 12+ industries and 2500+ customers.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.46% over past five years.
